lines: The entrance door that we had locked was swung open, and a flock of scarecrows came bustling in with a bang.
『Ohohohohohー!! May you all be swiftly crushed!』
Aiiieeeeeee!! L-Look out!! That expensive-looking furniture is raining down on uuuuuus!!
Shikanosuke let out a scream as he ran around to avoid the furniture and pieces of decoration attacking us.
That was most likely the work of poltergeists.
The skeleton manーthe butler of the Netherworld, seemed to be able to control the furniture and decorations inside the castle at will.
Let's get out of here, Fuma-chan! Heberybody really will be crushed fighting here!
Yeah, we retreat for now! Let's run, Shikanosuke!!
『Hnngh? So you choose to flee? Such cowardice!! ーGo, scarecrows! Do not let them escape from the castle!!』
We could hear the scarecrows' laughter close in behind us as they bounced along.
We ended up being chased by them around the castle for a while...
We'd finally lost the herd of scarecrows and were hiding in a room to rest.
Ugh, I can't believe this... I know I mentioned demons before for the fun of it, but I didn't think any would actually show up...
Monsters were Shikanosuke's weak point after all, and I could see he was still trembling as he spoke.
Well, less so demons, more evil spirits really. That monster called himself the butler of the Netherworld...
Seemed so. It looked like he really was protecting this castle and Yukikaze...
(On top of that, I feel like I've read about that ghost butler in some book or something...)
What was it again...? I cocked my head to the side pensively but couldn't quite manage to remember.
Th-Then in that case... Shouldn't we just apologize to that monster butler!?
It's not like we're actually Yukikaze's enemies or anything!!
Yeah, if you can get him to listen. Unfortunately, that old ghost is completely convinced that we are enemies.
And who's fault might that be, Fuma-chan...?
Hebiko looked at me with reproaching eyes.
I-I mean... Well, let's say I'll reflect on that later...
In the end, our only solution is to find Yukikaze or Clear and have them explain everything.
If we did that, that monster butler would finally understand that we had no ill-intent.
But... it'll be so hard to find them. This place is so big...
The building was so vastly large that it could easily be mistaken as a castle for some aristocratic lord.
According to what I learned from Hebiko as we were escaping,
the Mizuki clan was indeed an extremely wealthy family, and at the time of Yukikaze's grandfather, they even managed a bank.
W-Well, that's true but... can't you follow Yukikaze's scent with your sucker sensors?
No... Hebiko's already been trying to for a while.
Hebiko can feel her smell here and there, but she doesn't know where Yukikaze-chan is yet.
I see... Well, it is the house she usually lives in after all.
In that case, it meant our only choice was to give this place a thorough search...
We looked up, a startled look on our faces.
We were in the large and luxurious dining room of the Mizuki's mansion.
And from the darkness spreading out at the end of it, a figure was coming toward us...
